description_file.description: Path to a file containing introductory text to include at the beginning of the first generated message.

max_size.description: Maximum size in characters for partial messages. 0 means no limit. Overrides SPLITSIZE if set.

content_type.description: MIME type (subtype of application, audio, image, or video) for the attached file. Empty for auto-detection.

subject.description: Subject header for the MIME message. Empty to prompt or let command line handle.

attachment.description: If true, sets Content-Disposition to attachment. If false, sets it to inline.

newsgroups.description: Comma-separated list of newsgroups to post the message to. Leave empty to mail to recipients.

output_file.description: Path to write the generated MIME message. If splitting, appends .01, .02, etc.

recipients.description: List of email addresses to send the message to. Required if output_file and newsgroups are not set.

files.description: List of file paths to encode in MIME format.

tmp_dir.description: Directory to store temporary files during encoding.

splitsize.description: Value for the SPLITSIZE environment variable. Used if max_size is not set.
